title: Understanding the Logistic Regression Model
text: The logistic regression model predicts the probability of an event occurring. In this case, it predicts whether a student prefers Kendrick $$(y=1)$$ or Drake $$(y=0)$$. The model uses the formula: \( \hat{p} $$=$$ \frac{1}{1+e**{-z}} \), where \( $$z$$ $$=$$ $$\theta_0$$ + $$\theta_1 X_1$$ + $$\theta_2 X_2$$ \).

title: Compute the Linear Combination
text: Substitute the values into the equation: \( $$z$$ $$=$$ $$-2$$ + $$2\times1$$ + $$1\times0$$ \). What is the value of \( $$z$$ \)?

title: Calculate the Probability
text: Now that you have \( $$z$$ \), use the logistic function to find \( \hat{p} \): \( \hat{p} $$=$$ \frac{1}{1+e**{-z}} \).

title: Compute the Probability
text: Substitute \( $$z$$ $$=$$ $$0$$ \) into the logistic function: \( \hat{p} $$=$$ \frac{1}{1+e**{0}} \). What is \( \hat{p} \)?
